When you use a command, the user will respond with "Response: " followed by the output of the commmand. Use this output to help the user complete their request.

[DESCRIPTION]: The function takes a string input and appends the character "F" to the end of it. For example, "hello" becomes "helloF" and the empty string becomes "F".

